title: mirrorboard.toml
description: One organization's mirrorboard: its name, its owner, its config files and its units.

owner.description: The organization's account: account://<key of the accounts file>.

chains.description: Path of the chains file, relative to this file.

accounts.description: Path of the accounts file, relative to this file.

definitions.description: Path of the definitions file, relative to this file.

label.description: The organization's name as people read it.

units.description: Unit files: the parts of the organization, e.g. a department or a notary's own part; the key is the unit's name in addresses like agent://<unit>/<agent>.

unit.description: Path of the unit file, relative to this file.

template.description: Path of the unit template, relative to this file.

parameters.description: A value for every parameter the template lists; unit must equal this unit's key.
